## Now

M.S. candidate in Psychology: Data Science in Human Behavior at UW–Madison (expected Dec 2026). My capstone, **Digital-Mailroom**, is built with industry partner American Family Insurance. It looks for ways to cut the cost of AI inference and improve how documents are read, sorted, and managed.
